name: Loughborough University
description:
Loughborough University is an acclaimed institution located in the heart of England.

Placed in the Top 7 in every national university league table in the UK, the university pride themselves on their excellent teaching standard and student satisfaction rate.

Loughborough also has the largest sports scholarship programme in the UK with over 250 international athletes studying and training.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Loughborough University is one of the UK’s leading higher education institutions, boasting a reputation for excellence in teaching, research, and industry links. Originally founded in 1909 as a Technical Institute, it has grown into a world-renowned university, particularly famous for its sporting achievements and high-quality student experience.

The university is organised into multiple schools, including the Loughborough Business School, the School of Architecture, Building and Civil Engineering, and the School of Sport, Exercise and Health Sciences. It is consistently ranked in the top ten of major UK league tables and was named University of the Year for Sport in the Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide 2025.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value:
At Loughborough, you’ll find an inclusive community known as the #LboroFamily. The student experience is central to life here, with the university consistently ranking in the top three for student satisfaction.

You can join a wide variety of clubs and societies, with over 100 options available through the Loughborough Students' Union (LSU). Whether you’re interested in cultural activities, arts, or competitive sports, there’s a space for you to thrive and meet people from over 130 different countries.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Loughborough offers a range of high-quality accommodation to ensure you feel at home. From halls of residence located on/near campus to support in finding private accommodation nearby, the university does it all.

Moreover, if you’re an international fee-paying student and make Loughborough your firm choice, you’re guaranteed a room in university accommodation for two years.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
1. Library

The University Library is the largest open-access study space on campus, offering over 500,000 print books, 30,000 online journals, and 1,300 diverse study spaces. It also houses the Library Cafe for quick breaks.

2. Sports

Widely regarded as the best in the UK, the sports facilities include the National Centre for Sport and Exercise Medicine (NCSEM) and world-class gyms, athletics tracks, and swimming pools used by elite athletes.

3. Laboratories

The STEMLab is a GBP 17M dedicated learning environment featuring state-of-the-art laboratories and workshops for science and engineering students.

4. Cafeteria

You can choose from numerous dining spots across campus, including The Pantry, Meet & Eat, The Coffeehouse, and The Nutrition Bar, which focus on healthy and diverse food options.
